title: 14 CFR § 107.52 ATC transponder equipment prohibition. (2025 edition)

heading_path: 14 CFR § 107.52 ATC transponder equipment prohibition. (2025 edition)
sections.text:
Unless otherwise authorized by the Administrator, no person may operate a small unmanned aircraft system under this part with a transponder on.

[Amdt. 107-7, 86 FR 4513, Jan. 15, 2021]
